articles.title: Cantor and Securitize collaborate on blockchain-based IPOs
articles.snippet: The move creates a pathway for public companies to raise capital onchain and issue tokenized securities.

articles.title: AI agentic payments enter mainstream as Visa, Mastercard, Ripple back x402 standard
articles.snippet: Forty companies now govern x402, the protocol Coinbase built and handed away. It settled about $24 million across 75 million payments last month.

articles.title: Crypto firms face AML risks during post-MiCA migration, says AMLA chair
articles.snippet: AMLA is expanding its crypto oversight as firms complete the transition to the EU’s MiCA licensing regime.

articles.title: Stripe, Advent offer $53B to acquire PayPal: Report
articles.snippet: Stripe and Advent reportedly offered to buy PayPal for $53 billion, at a 28% premium compared to the company’s Tuesday closing price.

articles.title: Kalshi says CFTC, Michigan orders leave it in ‘impossible position’
articles.snippet: “We are disappointed by this decision and believe it is unfair to Kalshi,” the company’s legal counsel said on X.
